label: Use the direct recursive definition of finite list append
rationale: Reversing a list into an empty accumulator then reversing it onto ys equals structural append by induction on xs. Values, order and duplicates remain unchanged; allocation/stack behavior may differ.
domain: Extensional equality for finite lists of Data values; no pointer identity, stack-use or performance equivalence claim.
before:
def nt_append(-A: Data, xs: List<&2, A>, ys: List<&2, A>) -> List<&2, A>:
  nt_reverse(A, nt_reverse(A, xs, Nil{}), ys)
expectedBehavior: Reversing a list into an empty accumulator then reversing it onto ys equals structural append by induction on xs. Values, order and duplicates remain unchanged; allocation/stack behavior may differ.
